intro: If you created an account in Tenerife Go, you can delete it whenever you like: from the app or by email.
appTxt: Tap «{cuenta}» (sign in if asked) and then, below «{cerrar}», tap «{eliminar}». The app asks you to confirm with «{confirmar}», and the account is deleted right away.
correoTxt: Write to {correo} from your account’s email address, with the subject «{asunto}». We delete it no later than one month after receiving your email (GDPR, Article 12(3)).
borraTxt: Your email address, your password (stored encrypted), the favourites you have saved in the cloud and, if you saved them to your account, your profile and progress.
noTitulo: What is not deleted with the account
noPush: Notifications: you turn them off in your browser or in your phone’s settings.
noDispositivo: What is saved on your device, such as the language or your favourites: it disappears when you clear the site data in your browser or uninstall the app.
